reader_identity_mirror: Couples who have missed or been missed in a tiny phone moment.
emotional_obstacle: Attention is delayed just long enough for the little shared moment to disappear.
proof: The phone turns outward, lowers, flips roles, then finally turns face-down.
bridge: "one sec" feels harmless precisely because it is small.
relationship_motion: Mutual recognition replaces blame; both partners choose to face the shared moment.
payoff: Closeness returns when they lean over one screen and put both phones down.
send_save_reason: A viewer can tag their partner as a gentle promise not to leave each other on 'one sec.'
